title: Four Factors to Consider When Choosing a Plastic Surgeon in Baton Rouge

html:
If you’re considering plastic surgery, it’s important to choose the right plastic surgeon in Baton Rouge to guarantee the best results. The ideal surgeon has the expertise and skills to conduct the treatment you want successfully. If you settle for an inexperienced and unqualified surgeon, you risk getting undesirable results, wasting time and money, and suffering from surgical complications.

Whether you are considering breast augmentation, rhinoplasty, or liposuction, Hanemann Plastic Surgery assures the best results to help you attain your dream look. Below are four factors to consider when searching for a plastic surgeon in Baton Rouge.

1. Experience

Plastic surgery is a complex field that requires extensive experience and expertise. Choose a plastic surgeon in Baton Rouge who has numerous years of experience in the specific treatment you desire to maximize the probability of good results. Ask the surgeon the number of years they have been performing the treatment and how many times they have conducted it recently. Apart from experience, the surgeon should have the expertise to handle the treatment.

2. Board Certification

Board certification ascertains that a surgeon has the highest level of education and training and adheres to safety and ethical standards. The American Board of Plastic Surgery certifies plastic surgeons in Baton Rouge and America as a whole. Ensure that you choose a plastic surgeon in Baton Rouge who is board-certified to get the best outcomes.

3. Previous Work

When it comes to treatments that alter your appearance, experience and board certification are not enough; you have to assess a surgeon’s previous work. Evaluate the work of different plastic surgeons in Baton Rouge before you settle on one. Request for before and after photos of the treatment you are considering. Determine whether you like the surgeon’s work and if their results reflect how you want to look after the treatment.

4. Surgeon’s Personality

You will be spending a lot of time with your surgeon, both before and after the treatment. Therefore, ensure that your surgeon is available, able, professional, approachable, trustworthy, caring, and most importantly of all, listens to you. The difference between a good plastic surgeon in Baton Rouge and an exceptional one is their relationship with customers. Choose an exceptional plastic surgeon like Dr. Hanemann who has a great personality and strives to exceed customers’ needs.

If you are considering plastic surgery, do not hesitate to contact the experts at Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge. Schedule an appointment today with our incredible plastic surgeons who have the expertise, experience, and persona to meet your needs.
